report:
# DS-QM081-STOCHASTIC-L1-CONTRACTION

Three-state signed vectors test identity equality, genuine mixing and cancellation/reset. Every column, image coordinate, row triangle budget and input/output L1 value is exact. A fresh Lean theorem proves contraction for every finite rational rectangular kernel, with nonnegativity and column sums exactly1 as hypotheses.

Supported: Generic finite rational column-stochastic L1 contraction is kernel checked; retained three-state outputs and triangle budgets are exact.

Remaining: Transport the array implementation to the formal finite sums and any supplied quantum/CPTP interface. Classical contraction does not derive a quantum carrier.
